title: General vehicle rental conditions
intro: These are AB FAST CAR’s general rental conditions, as provided by the agency. The specific conditions for your rental are set out in your contract. If you have any questions, contact us before booking.

paragraphs: AB Fast Car undertakes to provide the customer with a clean, washed vehicle in good working order.
The customer undertakes to return the vehicle in the same general condition as when received, subject to normal wear resulting from use in accordance with the rental conditions.
Otherwise, the customer may be charged restoration costs, based on the damage observed and substantiated expenses.

The vehicle’s tyres are in good condition at departure. If a tyre is damaged for a reason other than normal wear, or if one goes missing, replacement costs may be charged to the customer when their liability is established. Replacement must comply with the vehicle’s dimensions, specifications and safety requirements.
Normal mechanical wear of the vehicle is borne by AB Fast Car.

Repairs made necessary by abnormal use of the vehicle, negligence by the customer, an accident or any other cause attributable to the customer shall be borne by the latter, within the limits set by the rental contract and applicable regulations.
Compensation for loss of use may be claimed when the contractual conditions and circumstances justify it, on the basis of evidence establishing the amount.
The rental is personal and cannot be transferred to a third party without AB Fast Car’s prior agreement.
The customer undertakes to entrust the driving of the vehicle only to persons authorised and named in the rental contract.
The customer must use the vehicle in accordance with its intended purpose, road safety rules and the conditions set out in the contract.
The vehicle is covered by the insurance cover taken out by AB Fast Car, in accordance with the conditions, limits, exclusions and excesses set out in the applicable insurance policy.
Cover for third-party liability, theft, fire and damage to the vehicle is as provided in the insurance contract.
Accessories, clothing, personal belongings and other items left inside the vehicle or in the boot are not covered by AB Fast Car’s insurance cover, unless an applicable provision states otherwise.
The number of people carried in the vehicle must not exceed the number of authorised seats.

sections.heading: Insurance excess in the event of an at-fault accident
paragraphs: In the event of an accident involving the rented vehicle, where the customer’s liability is established, wholly or in part, the customer undertakes to pay AB Fast Car an excess corresponding to 5 % of the value of the vehicle, according to the calculation basis defined in the rental contract and subject to the conditions of the applicable insurance policy.
In the event of shared liability, the arrangements for covering the costs shall be determined in accordance with the applicable rules and the conditions of the insurance contract.
The excess may only be claimed from the customer within the limits of their liability and the applicable contractual and insurance provisions.

sections.heading: Reporting an accident
paragraphs: In the event of an accident, theft or fire, the customer must inform AB Fast Car as soon as possible and take the necessary steps with the competent authorities and the insurer.
The customer must provide a detailed statement specifying, in particular, the circumstances of the event, the place, date, time and, as far as possible, witnesses’ contact details.
An agreed accident statement or a report drawn up by the competent authorities must be provided when necessary.
The rental amount and deposit are determined in accordance with the rates communicated to the customer and stated in their rental contract.
The rental is paid according to the arrangements agreed before the vehicle is handed over.
The deposit cannot automatically be used to pay for a rental extension.

If the customer wishes to keep the vehicle beyond the period initially agreed, they must obtain AB Fast Car’s prior agreement and pay the amount corresponding to the additional period according to the agreed arrangements.
Any extension must be expressly accepted by AB Fast Car.

In the absence of an agreement, the customer must return the vehicle on the date and at the time specified in the contract. Keeping the vehicle without authorisation may give rise to the measures provided for by applicable regulations.
The deposit is returned according to the arrangements set out in the contract, subject to any substantiated sums that may remain payable by the customer.
When returning the vehicle, the customer must hand over to AB Fast Car all documents, keys and accessories entrusted to them at collection.
If any document, key or accessory is missing, the customer must immediately inform the company.
Any replacement costs may be charged to the customer when their liability is established and the expenses are substantiated.
The customer is responsible for offences, fines, traffic tickets and costs legally attributable to their use of the vehicle during the rental period.
They undertake to comply with the Highway Code and all rules applicable to traffic and parking.
Sums payable for offences committed during the rental period may be claimed from the customer in accordance with applicable regulations.
The conditions for cancellation, early termination and refunds are those communicated to the customer before confirmation of their booking and specified in their rental contract.
If the customer terminates the rental early, the refund of any sums paid shall be determined in accordance with the applicable contractual conditions and regulations in force.
Any cancellation fees or non-refundable sums must be provided for in the conditions communicated to the customer and comply with applicable regulations.

articles.title: Use of the vehicle outside Morocco and prohibited use

paragraphs: The vehicle may not be driven outside Moroccan territory without AB Fast Car’s prior written authorisation and without checking the necessary authorisations and insurance cover.
Any use of the vehicle contrary to the contract, applicable regulations or insurance conditions may engage the customer’s liability within the limits set by law.
AB Fast Car cannot be held liable for the consequences of unauthorised or illegal use of the vehicle, subject to its legal obligations.

In the event of a disagreement concerning performance of this contract, the courts of the city of Rabat shall have sole jurisdiction, subject to mandatory jurisdiction rules under applicable regulations.
AB Fast Car undertakes to provide the customer with a clean, washed vehicle at collection.
The customer undertakes to return the vehicle clean, in a state of cleanliness equivalent to that observed at handover.
If the vehicle is returned dirty and requires a full wash, a flat cleaning fee of 150 Moroccan dirhams (MAD) shall be charged to the customer.

This fee covers a full vehicle wash. It does not cover any additional specialist cleaning costs that may be necessary in the event of exceptional soiling, subject to substantiation and the applicable contractual conditions.
A vehicle condition report may be drawn up at departure and return, in the presence of the customer or their representative.
This report may include photographs recording the vehicle’s exterior and interior condition, fuel level, mileage and the presence of documents and accessories handed over to the customer.
The customer is invited to report any anomaly or visible damage before taking possession of the vehicle.
If damage is observed on return, AB Fast Car may draw up a record of the damage and provide the customer with the corresponding supporting evidence.

articles.title: Returning the vehicle and late return

paragraphs: The customer undertakes to return the vehicle on the date, at the time and at the place agreed in the rental contract.
Any request for an extension must be communicated to AB Fast Car and accepted in advance.
In the event of an unauthorised late return, additional charges may be applied in accordance with the rate communicated to the customer and the conditions set out in the contract.
The customer must return the vehicle with the keys, documents and accessories provided at collection.
The applicable fuel level and mileage conditions are those specified in the rental contract.
Unless otherwise agreed, the customer undertakes to return the vehicle with a fuel level equivalent to that observed at departure.
Any missing fuel or excess mileage may be charged in accordance with the rates communicated to the customer before the rental.

articles.title: Maintenance and use of the vehicle

paragraphs: The customer undertakes to use the vehicle with care, in accordance with its intended purpose and road safety rules.
It is prohibited to use the vehicle for illegal activities, motor racing, unauthorised transport or any other use contrary to the contract or insurance conditions.
The customer must report to AB Fast Car without delay any breakdown, mechanical anomaly, warning light or situation likely to compromise the vehicle’s safety.
No major repair may be undertaken without the company’s prior agreement, except for an urgent measure necessary for people’s safety.
Booking and collecting the vehicle imply the customer’s acknowledgement of the rental conditions communicated to them and accepted by them in accordance with the arrangements set out in the contract.
The specific conditions stated in the rental contract supplement these general conditions.
In the event of a contradiction, the mandatory provisions of applicable regulations shall prevail.
AB Fast Car recommends that the customer carefully read all the conditions before confirming their booking.
